title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E dynamic debug configuration test teardown fails with EBUSY resource busy/locked on Windows temp workspace rmdir
test_name: Aspire dynamic debug configuration E2E "after each" hook for "does not launch an AppHost when the ambiguous AppHost picker is dismissed"
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
error_pattern:
AggregateError: Dynamic debug configuration E2E teardown failed.
1. Error: EBUSY: resource busy or locked, rmdir 'C:\Users\runneradmin\AppData\Local\Temp\aev-*\workspace\.e2e-dynamic-debug\*'
    at runE2eTeardown (out\test-e2e\test-e2e\helpers\fixtures.js:217:15)
analysis: Windows-specific filesystem race condition during test teardown: the temp directory is still locked/in-use by another process when rmdir is attempted. The PR under test only modifies Aspire.Dashboard components and has no relation to the VS Code extension or its E2E test infrastructure, indicating this is an environmental/infra flake rather than a regression caused by the PR.
